Project Role : Business Analyst

Project Role Description : Analyze an organization and design its processes and systems, assessing the business model and its integration with technology. Assess current state, identify customer requirements, and define the future state and/or business solution. Research, gather and synthesize information.

Must have skills : Business Requirements Analysis

Good To Have Skills: : NA
Minimum 5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
As a Business Analyst, a typical day involves examining the structure and operations of an organization to understand how its processes and systems function together. This role requires evaluating the existing business model and how it aligns with technological solutions. The Business Analyst spends time identifying the needs of customers and stakeholders, envisioning improved future states or solutions that enhance business performance. Gathering and synthesizing diverse information from various sources is a key part of the daily routine, enabling informed decision-making and strategic planning to support organizational goals.

Roles & Responsibilities:
  • Partner closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams to elicit, analyze, and refine requirements into clear, actionable deliverables.
  • Facilitate collaboration between business and technology teams to ensure alignment on project objectives and delivery expectations.
  • Design and document end-to-end business workflows, supporting campaign execution and system integrations.
  • Translate business requirements into detailed process flows, functional specifications, and user stories.
  • Drive Agile delivery practices through backlog grooming, prioritization, sprint planning support, and requirement refinement.
  • Write high-quality user stories with clear, AI-assisted acceptance criteria to enhance clarity, testability, and delivery speed.
  • Work closely with development, QA, and Product teams to ensure requirements are understood and successfully implemented.
  • Support continuous process improvement by identifying gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for optimization.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to validate solutions and ensure business objectives are met.

    Professional & Technical Skills:
    Must To Have Skills:
  • Proficiency in Business Requirements Analysis.
    Strong experience in requirement gathering, stakeholder management, and business process analysis.
  • Ability to design and document end-to-end workflows and process maps.
    Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, including backlog grooming and user story creation.
  • Proficiency in defining clear and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex business needs into actionable technical requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and database tools (PostgreSQL or similar) for data analysis and validation.
  • Ability to validate data requirements, support reporting needs, and ensure data accuracy across workflows.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with cross-functional teams.

    Nice To Have Skills
  • Understanding of marketing platforms and campaign management ecosystems.
  • Exposure to customer engagement tools such as Unica, Adobe Campaign, or Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Experience in Functional Testing, Performance Testing, and/or Test Automation.
  • Familiarity with campaign workflows, customer engagement processes, and system integrations.

  • The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Business Requirements Analysis.
  • This position is based at our Pune office.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.

    Qualification 15 years full time education

title: IT Supplier Management Practitioner
jobDescription:
Project Role : IT Supplier Management Practitioner

Project Role Description : Work with key IT suppliers (either for Accenture internally or for clients) by assisting on supplier selection, management and related procurement for a limited number of strategic suppliers. Also responsible for assisting in architecting, selling and delivering IT Spend Management (IT Business Management) services to clients, including proposal creation, service delivery cost estimating, due diligence, negotiating and contracting with suppliers, client presentations, and client service delivery.

Must have skills : Network Infrastructures

Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary
The Full Stack Hybrid Network Engineer is responsible for the operations and management of hybrid network infrastructures. This role specializes in maintaining core routing and switching, cloud networking, SDWAN/LAN/Wireless, and firewall platforms. The engineer leverages automation, scripting, and AI-aided observability tools, including Agentic AI frameworks to ensure resilient, secure, and efficient network operations across multi-vendor and multi-cloud environments.

Key Responsibilities:
Operate, monitor, and maintain core routing and switching network infrastructure (Juniper, Meraki, Fortinet, or similar).
Manage and support SDWAN (Cisco Viptela, Velocloud, PaloAlto etc.)
Manage and support LAN/Wireless solutions on Juniper Mist, Meraki, and/or Fortinet platforms, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
Administer firewall platforms such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco and/or Juniper, supporting secure connectivity and policy enforcement.
Oversee cloud networking environments (Azure, AWS, GCP), including cloud-native network controls and integrations.
Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize network infrastructure using AI-aided observability and management tools.
Automate network operations and routine tasks using scripting languages (Python, Ansible, or similar) and orchestration platforms.
Apply Agentic AI frameworks to enhance network observability, automation, and self-healing capabilities.
Ensure compliance with networking best practices and organizational policies.
Evaluate and implement new networking technologies and tools to improve operational efficiency.
Provide technical support and guidance to team members, clients, and stakeholders.

Required Skills:
Strong proficiency in core routing and switching (Juniper, Meraki, Fortinet, or similar).
Hands-on experience with SDWAN/LAN/Wireless platforms (Juniper Mist, Meraki, Fortinet).
Experience with firewall platforms (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Juniper and Cisco).
Experience in cloud networking (Azure, AWS, GCP).
Experience in automation and scripting (Python, Ansible, or similar).
Experience with AI-aided network observability and management tools.
Understanding of Agentic AI frameworks for network operations.
Ability to troubleshoot complex network incidents and infrastructure issues.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Certifications (Required/Preferred):
Cisco Certified Specialist - Enterprise SD-WAN Implementation
Juniper Networks Certified Associate Professional
Meraki ECMS Engineering Cisco Meraki Solutions
Fortinet NSE Level 4
Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE)
Certified Cloud Network Engineer (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
PCEP Certified Entry-Level Python Programmer
Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Network Automation (EX457)

Qualification 15 years full time education

  • Spend and compliance reporting
  • Commercial risk management
  • Contract Management
  • Supplier Relationship Management
  • Peer group or market network build

    What are we looking for
  • Execute sourcing plans in line with global standards and policies
  • Assist and coordinate on global and geographic contract negotiations effectively to deliver robust terms and conditions that manages clients service delivery and commercial risk that represent value for money
  • Build strong supplier base relationships and manage negotiation and supplier selection within the framework of the category strategies and sourcing strategies
  • Lead global and geographic supplier management and drive geographic continuous improvement initiatives with suppliers in coordination with business functions
  • Monitor contractual performance in accordance with agreed SLAs to identity and resolve issues, escalating as appropriate
  • Ability to understand and communicate the individual category strategy to internal stakeholders
  • Business Continuity plan execution and pro-active risk management.
  • Ability to leverage generative AI to improve efficiency in tasks such as RFP drafting, spend classification, data summarization, and contract review
  • Foundational understanding of how generative AI works and its evolving role in procurement technology
  • Demonstrated openness to adopting emerging technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation in sourcing practices Education / Qualifications / Certifications Required
  • Educated to degree level or equivalent in a relevant area
  • CIPS Corporate Diploma in Purchasing and/or membership of The Chartered Institute for Purchasing and Supply or equivalent country qualification or membership would be an advantage

    Roles and Responsibilities: ESSENTIAL Experience Required
  • Identify cost/productivity improvement opportunities in spending across different categories ie. IT, Logistics, CPS, marketing, etc.
  • Execution of end-to-end sourcing projects, including all key steps such as strategy development, category planning, supplier negotiation, technocommercial evaluation, award recommendations, business case presentations and supplier contract execution, leveraging an Agile approach to drive efficiency in execution.
  • End to end knowledge and experience in E-Auction, reverse e-auction sourcing process and strategy.
  • Provide industry and supplier research, market intelligence and financial analyses.
  • Pursue and develop stakeholder relationships (internal and external).
  • Support Category Strategy development to identify project opportunities that achieve client goals and mature their procurement function.
  • Able to help and support on industry best practices with a special emphasis on market trends and insights, commercial structure assessment, negotiation strategies and contracting.
  • Contract life cycle management, including Variations/amendments and closures.
  • Understand the level of risk propose mitigation plans and partner with your lead and other support teams to resolve requests/issues in a timely manner.
  • The resource should also be able to work with the legal and technical teams to facilitate and assist the negotiations of the legal and technical terms in a contract.
  • Ability to negotiate and close the contract with advice from legal and technical/ business teams.
  • At least 50% of experience should be in managing global client stakeholders and global suppliers (for India). Technical / Functional / Leadership Skills Required
  • Knowledge of the Category including the external marketplace, key drivers and levers, supply base and balance of power, supplier capabilities and trends
  • Strong Stakeholder Management skillset
  • Expertise in negotiation skills and influencing skills: able to influence business partners and suppliers as well as the ability to be assertive if required to ensure compliance to contract
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  • Strong digital analytical and numerical ability
  • Ability to develop and maintain effective partnerships working across geographic boundaries and functions
  • A focus on service delivery and savings
  • Preferably IWS / Lean Manufacturing experience
  • Tools knowledge e.g., SAP-SD/MM modules, Ariba, Coupa.
  • Advanced Proficiency in MS Office (i.e. Excel, PowerPoint, Power Bi, Access, Word)

Our media organization is growing, and strong performance at scale requires more than talented Media Buyers.
We need leaders who can build the systems, processes, and operating rhythms that allow teams to deliver consistently as client volume grows.
The Media Operations Manager will manage Media Buying teams while owning the systems that support their performance. You will be responsible for turning a group of capable individuals into a well-run operating unit.
You will work closely with Media Buying leadership and cross-functional teams to improve execution, capacity, quality, and team performance.

You will determine what needs to happen consistently across accounts and build practical systems that make that possible.
Manage team performance

You will create a clear feedback loop between individual performance, team performance, and client outcomes.
Improve operational efficiency

You will redesign processes and introduce tools, automation, and documentation where they create meaningful improvements.
Manage capacity and resources
You will monitor workload across teams and make recommendations around account allocation, hiring, staffing, and resource requirements.

Develop leaders

Role Responsibilities
  • Analyse large, complex data sets using statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms to uncover trends, patterns, and insights that drive business value
  • Develop predictive models and algorithms to solve business problems and optimise processes, leveraging techniques such as regression analysis, classification, clustering, and time series forecasting
  • Design and implement experiments to test hypotheses and validate models, and iterate based on feedback and results to improve model accuracy and performance
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including data engineers, software developers, and business stakeholders, to understand data requirements, define success criteria, and deliver actionable insights and solutions
  • Communicate findings and insights effectively to non-technical stakeholders through visualisations, presentations, and storytelling, and provide recommendations for business decisions and strategy
  • Stay updated on emerging trends, tools, and techniques in data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, and share knowledge and insights with the team
Expected Outcomes
  • Develop and deploy machine learning models and algorithms that provide actionable insights and drive business decisions and solutions
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver solutions that meet or exceed expectations
  • Contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement, fostering a positive and productive work environment
Special Notes
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in data science or related roles, with expertise in statistical analysis, machine learning, and data visualisation
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, and experience with data science libraries and frameworks such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch
  • Strong understanding of data manipulation, cleaning, and preprocessing techniques, and experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and analytical thinking, with the ability to derive insights from complex data sets and communicate findings effectively
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with stakeholders across different functions and levels

THE COMPANY

Careerminds is a leader in career transition and coaching solutions, helping organizations support employees through change while enabling workforce growth and development. Our product portfolio includes market-leading Career Transition and Coaching Services as well as Progression, our application for Career Frameworks and progression planning.

THE ROLE

Were growing our machine learning team. Were looking for Machine Learning Engineers who own products end to end - from the problem, to production, to the metric that proves it worked.

This role exists because of how we build. A small product strategy team sets direction and priorities; engineers own the work end to end - discovery, design, build, ship, and the result. Youll have the autonomy of a founder inside your domain and the accountability that comes with it.

That accountability includes the unglamorous half of ML. You own the experiment that doesnt pan out and the call to kill it, not just the launch. Wed rather you run four honest experiments and ship the one that works than ship four things that all look fine on a dashboard.

AI-native development isnt an aspiration here - its the baseline. Our engineers ship with Claude Code and Claude Design as their default tools, and the leverage that creates is why one engineer can own a product end to end.

We want people already working this way who want to push the ceiling higher, not people who are curious about AI. In the interview well ask you to show us the trail: repos, PRs, or shipped work you built this way.

This is a 100% remote/work-from-home role.

THE KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Depending on area of focus:

Canonical data and entity resolution

  • Canonical datasets for titles, companies, skills, and industries - the layer every application depends on. Content-addressed IDs, faceted taxonomies, alias graphs accumulated across tens of millions of rows.
  • Rules-based resolution pipelines with LLM escalation, where the accumulated alias graph is the durable asset and escalation volume should fall over time.
  • Nightly agent loops that adjudicate ambiguous entities, propose structural changes, and get gated by invariant checks and blast-radius limits before anything commits.
  • Job ingestion at scale: multi-source feeds, deduplication, freshness, and the indexing economics underneath.

Retrieval, ranking, and matching

  • Job matching v2: two-tower retrieval with cross-encoder reranking, trained on outcome labels rather than clicks. Hard-negative mining, propensity weighting, impression-time logging.
  • Mobility embeddings learned from observed career sequences - the similarity a text encoder cant recover, where Claims Adjuster and Underwriting Assistant are substitutable despite sharing no vocabulary.
  • Pivot feasibility: given where someone is, what moves are realistic, whats missing, and which intermediate roles actually worked for peers.

Applied LLMs and agents

  • Fine-tuning where it earns its cost - against outcome labels, not for tasks a well-prompted frontier model already handles.
  • Agentic systems in production with human approval gates: agents that analyze, propose changes as reviewable artifacts, and execute only after a human signs off. We have this pattern running against tens of millions of customer touchpoints a year and want to push it much further.
  • Continuous skills inference from work artifacts rather than static documents - a problem several of our enterprise customers are currently solving for themselves, badly.
  • New product surfaces where the right answer genuinely requires an LLM, and the discipline to notice when it doesnt.

Across all of it

  • Evaluation infrastructure youd defend in a design review: time-forward splits, calibration, offline-to-online agreement, and honest handling of feedback-loop degeneration and survivorship bias.
  • Building inside real constraints: GDPR, EU AI Act high-risk classification for employment AI, and client data commitments are design inputs here, not someone elses problem.

  • 5+ years shipping ML systems into production - and you can name the system, the metric before and after, and how you knew the model caused the change.

descriptionFromApi:
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns werent really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, theyd come back every day; once there was habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.
This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place - one app, local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight: when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies and marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalizing. Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission: to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the knowledge, opportunities, tools, and experts theyve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
  • Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)
  • Social & Community - a place to find and post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • & many more in testing & experimental space
Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight + AI. When someone opens a product weve built, they dont wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
This is the story new teammates walk into: a company that started as a WhatsApp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the center: access changes lives. We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.
Four of those focused apps - GyanTV, Sahi English, Poster Maker, and Matrimony - run on subscription revenue. Whats missing is one owner who can see all four at once, allocate the next rupee and the next hire across them, and build the acquisition and monetization engine as a single system instead of four disconnected ones.
You will own subscription revenue - the whole number, not a slice of it - across four products with four different consumers, four different LTV curves, and one shared marketing org that you build and run. This is not a "run performance marketing" role. Its a P&L seat, sitting in leadership, parallel to the product heads, not underneath them - partnering with them as an equal.
What youll own
The number Total subscription revenue across the four-product portfolio, tracked on revenue scale and LTV/CAC - not spend, not impressions, not a ROAS target handed down from someone else.
Acquisition, end-to-end
  • Performance marketing across Meta, Google, and emerging channels, with an explicit mandate to cut single-platform dependence
  • ASO and organic pull, so growth isnt 100% spend-led
  • Influencer marketing and channel mix decisions across four audiences that dont look alike
  • High-volume, vernacular-first creative testing - an iteration engine, not a monthly campaign calendar
  • CAC optimization as an ongoing discipline, not a one-time fix - continuously testing channel mix, bidding strategy, and creative to bring CAC down without starving volume
Funnel and experimentation
  • Building and owning the full product and marketing funnel - awareness through acquisition, activation, trial, paid conversion, and win-back
  • Running a structured, high-velocity experimentation engine across funnel stages: pricing tests, paywall placement, onboarding flows, creative-to-landing-page match
  • Bringing genuinely new growth plays to the table, not just optimizing what already exists
Monetization mechanics
  • Pricing, packaging, trial design, paywall placement, autopay mandate economics, and win-back
  • The line between ad promise and in-app delivery - if the hook oversells, trial-to-paid conversion and trust both break, and thats your problem to prevent
Money and people
  • Marketing budget allocation across four businesses with different LTV curves - deciding where the next rupee and the next hire go is a live judgment call, not a formula
  • Building and running a multi-function team: performance marketing, lifecycle/CRM, creative, ASO, growth analytics
The rigor underneath it
  • Blended and channel-level ROAS, M0-to-payback visibility, and CAC/payback targets set by product and category - a single blended number tells you nothing across four different businesses
  • Incrementality and attribution done properly - MMM plus platform data, not last-click
  • Compliant, resilient account structures and creative guidelines for categories that get scrutinized hard - personal finance-adjacent and matrimony traffic doesnt survive lazy account hygiene
What Youll Bring
  • 5+ years of relevant growth marketing experience, with a track record you can walk through in detail - not just describe at a high level
  • Youve owned a revenue P&L before, ideally in a subscription business - not just a spend budget or a ROAS target someone else set for you
  • Experience scaling a business to 200-300 Cr+ in annual revenue, or managing a business generating 8-10 Cr+ in monthly revenue - youve operated at a scale where the trade-offs are real and the margin for error is thin
  • Strong, hands-on expertise in CAC optimization and performance marketing - you can walk through exactly how you brought CAC down while protecting volume and quality
  • Proven ability to build and optimize product and marketing funnels end to end, with a bias toward experimentation - you treat the funnel as something to be continuously rebuilt, not a fixed pipe you pour spend into
  • Youve run growth across more than one product or business line at once, and made real trade-off calls between competing bets with a shared budget
  • You know India consumer subscription mechanics cold: UPI autopay/e-mandate economics, low-ARPU high-volume funnels, vernacular creative at scale - this isnt a market youre learning on the job
  • Experience in subscription-based business models is strongly preferred - you understand content/subscription LTV curves, churn, and win-back dynamics specifically
  • Youre fluent in ad-platform policy and account health, and have built compliant creative guidelines and resilient account structures for a regulated or heavily scrutinized category (fintech-adjacent, matrimony, health, etc.)
  • You can talk unit economics without notes: CAC, payback period, cohort LTV, blended and channel ROAS, and the MMM/attribution stack underneath them
  • Youve built a marketing org, not just operated inside one - hiring, structuring, and managing performance / CRM / creative / ASO / analytics functions
  • You have a real network across ad platforms, agencies, and creative supply that you can activate in month one, not month six
How Youll Be Measured
Total subscription revenue and LTV/CAC across the portfolio. Everything above is in service of that number.

Job Summary

Test Architect / Tech Lead - CTI MD Tech (GRA/GSC)

Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) and Global Scientific Communications (GSC) together own how Lilly's medicines move through health authority review, stay compliant once approved, and get communicated externally - spanning regulatory submissions, labelling, clinical trial disclosures, and scientific publications. Both functions operate under strict compliance and audit-readiness requirements, and are scaling agentic and generative AI capabilities across their platforms, creating a growing need for consistent, reusable test automation and AI quality engineering practices across GRA and GSC.

The Test Architect / Tech Lead (R4), GRA/GSC is accountable for building the test automation frameworks and reusable testing components that drive quality engineering across GRA and GSC, with particular depth in evaluating and validating generative AI and agentic systems. The role also carries tech lead accountability: designing and building the application architecture for GRA/GSC platforms and owning delivery of key initiatives end to end, not solely test strategy. This is a single R4 path role by design: test standards, automation architecture, and application architecture need to be set once and held consistently rather than fragmented across roles without the seniority to drive strategic evolution end to end. The role owns the build-out of reusable frameworks and components, drives test automation initiatives, leads delivery of key technical initiatives, and manages stakeholders to ensure quality and AI evaluation rigor scale consistently as GRA/GSC's agentic platforms mature.

Path/Level: R4 (Test Architect / Tech Lead)

Key Responsibilities

  • Reusable Test Framework Development - design, build, and own reusable test automation frameworks and shared components (libraries, harnesses, fixtures, evaluation pipelines) that can be adopted consistently across GRA and GSC rather than rebuilt per program.
  • Application Architecture & Design - design and build the application architecture for GRA/GSC platforms as a tech lead - defining technical approach, component design, and integration patterns alongside the test and quality strategy.
  • Delivery Ownership - act as tech lead for key technical initiatives, owning end-to-end delivery - from architecture and build through testing and release - and holding accountability for outcomes, not just quality gates.
  • Automation Enablement - drive test automation efforts across GRA and GSC, identifying opportunities to replace manual and duplicated testing effort with shared, scalable automation.
  • AI & Agentic Quality Engineering - build and own evaluation frameworks for generative AI and agentic systems - groundedness validation, hallucination detection, relevance/accuracy testing, and RAG and LLM evaluation - using tools such as RAGAS, DeepEval, and LLM-as-a-Judge approaches.
  • Test Initiative Leadership - define and drive test initiatives end to end - scoping, prioritizing, and delivering automation and quality-engineering improvements across concurrent teams and workstreams.
  • Stakeholder Management - partner with engineering leads, product owners, and quality/compliance stakeholders to align on architecture, delivery plans, test strategy, and adoption of shared frameworks.
  • Observability & Trace Analysis - establish agent observability and trace-analysis practices to diagnose failures in multi-agent and agentic workflows, and feed findings back into architecture, framework, and test design.
  • Synthetic Test Data & Coverage Strategy - build synthetic test data generation capabilities and apply risk-based prioritization to determine test depth and coverage across critical workflows.
  • Talent Development & Mentorship - mentor test engineers and technical leads, building a team capable of operating independently on architecture, framework design, automation, and AI evaluation.

Technical & Strategic Expertise Areas

Application & Solution Architecture AI Evaluation Frameworks (RAGAS, DeepEval, LLM-as-a-Judge) Groundedness Validation Hallucination Detection Relevance & Accuracy Testing Generative AI Testing Agentic AI Testing RAG Validation LLM Evaluation Prompt Engineering & Context Validation Multi-Agent Systems Agentic Frameworks AI Quality Engineering End-to-End Test Automation API & Integration Testing Agent Observability & Trace Analysis Synthetic Test Data Generation Python JavaScript/TypeScript

Basic Qualifications

  • Proven track record architecting and scaling test automation frameworks across multiple concurrent programs.
  • Demonstrated experience designing application architecture and leading end-to-end delivery of key technical initiatives as a tech lead.
  • Demonstrated experience driving technical direction for AI-driven or agentic platforms, not solely test execution.
  • Experience setting quality/validation standards enforced consistently across distributed or vendor-delivered teams.
  • Track record of operating with seniority across functional boundaries in ambiguous, fast-scaling transformation environments.

Additional Qualifications / Competencies

  • Experience in both Global Regulatory Affairs and Scientific Communications, or comparable regulated pharma functions.
  • Familiarity with Regulatory Content and Submission Management, Veeva RIM, and regulatory platforms.
  • Experience with document and content management ecosystems.
  • Background in pharma and GxP-regulated environments.

jobDescription:
Who are we

At Finastra, we re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission-critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

What will you contribute

Reporting to the Global Head of Data Governance, this position will play a key role on the Enterprise Data Governance team, supporting the implementation and ongoing development of data governance initiatives across Finastra. It involves both business and technical responsibilities, with an emphasis on assisting in the development, configuration, and maintenance of Finastra s enterprise data governance systems. This team will help drive a global transformation Finastra s data governance program, which will not only meet and exceed security, regulatory and compliance requirements, but also accelerate innovation in the development of data, analytic and AI products, unlocking new opportunities for monetization.

Responsibilities & Deliverables

Business Domain Leadership

  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of assigned business domains, including business processes, objectives, regulatory requirements, and key performance indicators.
  • Partner with business leaders to identify strategic data opportunities and challenges.
  • Act as the primary Data Office representative for assigned domains.
  • Facilitate alignment between business priorities and enterprise data initiatives.

Data Domain Management

  • Establish and maintain data domain structures, ownership models, and governance processes.
  • Define and manage domain roadmaps aligned to enterprise data strategy.
  • Drive accountability for data assets, critical data elements (CDEs), and metadata within assigned domains.
  • Promote domain-centric operating models and data product thinking across the organization.

Data Governance

  • Lead the implementation and adoption of data governance policies, standards, and controls.
  • Partner with Data Owners, Data Stewards, and technology teams to ensure compliance with governance requirements.
  • Oversee data quality, metadata management, lineage, classification, and data lifecycle activities.
  • Support regulatory, risk, privacy, audit, and compliance initiatives through effective governance practices.
  • Monitor governance KPIs and drive continuous improvement programs.

Data Products & Business Value

  • Collaborate with business and technology teams to identify, prioritize, and govern enterprise data products.
  • Support the definition of data product requirements, success metrics, and value realization.
  • Promote self-service analytics and trusted data consumption across business units.
  • Ensure data products are aligned with business outcomes and strategic objectives.

Data Strategy Support

  • Assist the Global Head of Data Governance in the development and execution of enterprise data strategy.
  • Contribute to data maturity assessments, roadmap development, and strategic planning activities.
  • Support executive reporting, governance councils, and steering committees.
  • Develop presentations, metrics, and reporting materials for senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Provide recommendations on data-related investments, priorities, and operating model enhancements.

Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership

  • Build strong relationships with business, technology, risk, compliance, and operational teams.
  • Drive organizational adoption of data governance, data stewardship, and domain ownership practices.
  • Facilitate governance forums, workshops, and stakeholder engagement sessions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on data-related matters across the enterprise.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years experience supporting global data governance and data management initiatives, preferably in banking, fintech or other highly regulated industries.
  • Proven expertise in implementing data catalog frameworks, controls, and monitoring processes across complex data ecosystems.
  • Proficiency in SQL and experience with programming languages such as Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams including data stewards, engineers, compliance, and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to lead root cause analysis and remediation of data quality issues across multiple systems and domains.
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements such as BCBS 239, GDPR, or other data-related compliance standards.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a detail-oriented mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical data issues into business language.
  • Experience in the banking or financial services sector is considered a plus.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (Master s degree is a plus).
  • Strong understanding of data governance principles, metadata management, data quality, and data management frameworks.
  • Proven ability to support strategic implementation, manage change, and deliver results under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, including product, legal, privacy, risk, and security teams.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Professional certifications in data governance (e.g., CDMP, ADGP, IGP) are advantageous.

Flexibility: Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

Sustainability: Paid time off for volunteering and donation-matching opportunities to support causes that matter to you.

Inclusion: Get involved in our inclusion communities, such as Count Me In, Culture@Finastra, Proud@Finastra, Disabilities@Finastra, and Women@Finastra-open to everyone who wants to participate and contribute.

Career Development: Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

Recognition: Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique-bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

Be unique. Be exceptional. Help us make a difference at Finastra.

Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude Code

Comfortable working with monetisation and payment flows (credits, subscriptions, in-app purchases)

Solid computer science foundations: algorithms, data structures, concurrency, threading

Nice to have

Computer Science/Tech related degrees

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices (TeamCity or similar)

Swift 6 / strict-concurrency experience

Protobuf/gRPC or other schema-driven API tooling

Unidirectional/Redux-style architecture experience (TCA or similar)

Tuist, Bazel, or other modular build systems at scale

Experience shipping multiple app targets from one codebase

Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks and feature flagging for gradual rollouts

Knowledge of socket-based networking and binary protocols

Familiarity with analytics, remote reporting, and performance metrics

Youll ship features for millions of users from a modular Swift monorepo that powers iOS App apps in the portfolio. You will own and drive product & technical projects from idea through to delivery and post-production monitoring.

The iOS App app is a mature, entirely-Swift codebase: UIKit-based, MVVM with coordinators and generated dependency injection, our in-house BPObservables reactive layer, and a protobuf-based API talking to iOS Apps high-scale backend (with some components on gRPC stack). Chat is built on Chatto, our open-source messaging framework. Youll both build the iOS App product and shape what the modern codebase becomes.

Architecture matters here. The platforms direction is set: new modules are written to the modern standard, so youll maintain and evolve a production UIKit app while writing new work on the modern stack and helping carry iOS App there.

What youll do

Build and ship user-facing features end-to-end across iOS Apps feature modules

Partner closely and collaborate cross-functionally with Backend and Android, QA, Product & Design teams

Work with a protobuf/gRPC API layer shared with our backend teams - you will own the client side of the contract

Write new modules to the modern platform standard (SwiftUI) while keeping the existing UIKit/MVVM codebase healthy

Test at every level: XCTest unit tests, snapshot tests, component/UI testing; extend coverage where its thin

Verify your changes end-to-end on supported devices using our test tooling to ensure high-quality standard and delightful member experience for shipped changes

Run A/B experiments, measure impact, and iterate with product and design

Adopt AI tools to accelerate ideation, prototyping, and iteration on new features, enabling faster experimentation with production-ready code

Participate in code reviews and mentor

Maintain and evolve the iOS App app (occasionally support other apps from iOS App Inc. portfolio) and contribute to the evolution of iOS App s codebase

Contribute to incident management - ensuring 100% of incidents are handled, postmortems written, and actions taken

Build and maintain monetisation logic like credits-based flows, subscription features

Our stack: Swift (essentially 100% of app code) UIKit with SwiftUI in newer modules MVVM + Coordinators, code-generated DI BPObservables (in-house reactive) with some Combine MAPI protobuf/gRPC networking Cosmos design system Tuist monorepo XCTest + SnapshotTesting + demo-app component tests

  • Exposure to performance reporting, executive dashboards, and governance-heavy delivery environments

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We re looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test with extensive industry experience to define and execute the design, development, and maintenance of Fivetran s test automation tools and framework using reliable and scalable techniques.

As a Senior SDET, you will focus on solving complex testing difficulties by designing, developing and improving automation and reporting frameworks. You will invest in improving test stability and performance of the framework by developing innovative solutions to boost Fivetran s testing efficiency. You will also coach Fivetran quality engineers to be the best in class automation engineers, and will continuously work with the team to ensure high standards for automation. The ideal candidate will be highly technical, detail-oriented, creative, motivated, and focused on achieving results.

In addition, this role emphasizes leveraging AI driven solutions to accelerate testing, enhance developer productivity, and improve operational insights, making Fivetran s quality practices smarter, faster, and more scalable.

This is a full-time position based out of our Bangalore office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

Technologies You ll Use

  • Languages & Frameworks: Java (17+), JUnit, REST Assured, Shell scripting; Python
  • Infrastructure & Tooling: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Bazel, Buildkite
  • Cloud & Platform: AWS, GCP, Azure
  • Observability & Monitoring: Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog
  • CI/CD & Automation: Jenkins, CircleCI, GitHub Actions
  • Data & Testing:ELT pipelines, test automation utilities, whitebox testing strategies
  • Databases: SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, SAP , Oracle, DB2 ertc)

What You ll Do

  • Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide meaningful, risk-focused feedback.
  • Design and evolve scalable automation frameworks in Java with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and data correctness.
  • Write high-signal test strategies for complex features and automate them across multiple environments.
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines by building robust validation layers that prevent silent failures and regressions.
    • Build internal tools and proof-of-concepts using AI/LLM technologies to:
    • Accelerate debugging and failure triaging
    • Generate high-quality test scenarios
    • Detect flaky patterns or regression risks
    • Improve log analysis and root-cause identification
    • Enhance developer and QA productivity
  • Design AI-assisted workflows that integrate seamlessly into the existing automation and release pipelines.
  • Experiment with and implement agent-based systems or LLM-powered tooling that streamline development and testing processes.
  • Actively measure and improve engineering impact through reliability metrics, automation efficiency, and defect prevention signals.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to drive a culture of quality ownership and automation-first thinking.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product leaders to align testing priorities and business objectives.

Skills We re Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in the software industry with strong passion for quality, automation, and engineering excellence.
  • Deep understanding of OOP principles and strong proficiency in Java.
  • Expertise in designing scalable automation frameworks and identifying negative, edge, and high-risk scenarios.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems risks such as schema drift, idempotency failures, data inconsistencies, and race conditions.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines with tools such as Jenkins, Buildkite.
  • Experience working with backend automation frameworks.
  • Testing data pipeline or ELT platforms, with hands-on exposure to Change Data Capture (CDC) mechanisms, connector-based data ingestion, and validating data accuracy and consistency across source and destination systems at scale.
  • Deep understanding of database internals
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI/LLM tools to significantly accelerate development, debugging, test design or automation activities.
  • Experience building AI-assisted tools, workflows, or agents that integrate into engineering pipelines.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience testing against cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) or CDC source databases (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Familiarity with log-based CDC mechanisms (binlog, WAL, ) and handling schema drift or evolution scenarios.
  • Exposure to distributed systems testing, large-scale data reconciliation, and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) on cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • Familiarity with data extraction using API-based polling, batch/file ingestion, and query-based incremental syncs.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

About the role:

Position Title: Legal Operations - Technology Manager

Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President

Internal Title: Manager

Reporting to: Vice President/ Director

Location: Bangalore, BCIT park, Thannisandra Main Road

Shift toimings: EMEA Shifts

MUFG Legal department in EMEA

The Legal department in Europe, Middle East and Africa (together, EMEA ) provides legal services to and manages the legal risk for MUFG Bank and MUFG Securities (EMEA) and the MUSHD international business (collectively the Firm ).

Members of Legal are dual-hatted across MUFG Bank and MUFG Securities. Dual-hat employees will be expected to be entity neutral across all responsibilities to ensure that services are provided to both entities effective and without favour or detriment to the other entity.

MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

MUFG s Legal department globally has a business plan priority to grow the global corporate centre legal team in India. The MGS Legal team currently supports the EMEA, APAC and Americas regions with hiring currently led through the EMEA region.

We have an exciting opportunity for a manager to join the MGS Legal Operations team to support with managing our legal technology platforms and related vendor relationships. We are looking for candidates who are proactive and organised with existing experience of implementing and managing technology.

From time to time, MUFG may ask individuals to develop new areas of practice either where this is required to meet business needs and/or as part of an individual s career progression.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

In this role, the successful candidate will be providing services which cover MUFG s banking arm and securities business under a dual-hat arrangement. Under this arrangement, the employee will act and make decisions on behalf of both the bank and the securities business, subject to the same remit and level of authority, and irrespective of the entity which employs them.

Key responsibilities:

Technology platform implementation, management and adoption

  • Responsible for the administration of the legal technology stack (Leah AI, various apps built on Power Platform (Legal Matter Management, Policy Approvals, Legal Spend Management), Legal Holds, Lyncs, BriefAI etc) working closely with relevant Technology teams including:
    • administer and configure, where required, workspaces, libraries, folder structures, and access controls
    • manage user provisioning, group policies, roles and permissioning line with security and governance standards
    • support troubleshooting and co-ordinate with relevant Technology teams and outside vendors to ensure that service support is delivered effectively and in a timely manner
    • understand and co-ordinate any version upgrades, service updates and patches
    • manage the renewal and lifecycle of legal tools ensuring cost-effectiveness and feature alignment
  • Responsible to support the use of technology for knowledge sharing including Legal s intranet pages (on KIZUNA), Teams spaces, use of shared drives - create and maintain pages, support de-duplication and standardisation efforts of each team, support sharing of key knowledge with the business
  • Responsible to understand technologies available in the wider organisation and in the market that can be used to drive the Legal Department s strategy and objectives e.g. enterprise agentic AI tools etc - this role will bring together the technical capabilities of tools available and the Legal Department s needs and will influence the technology roadmap of the department
  • Responsible to build no-code / low-code applications, workflows, agents for use by the Legal Department using enterprise technology stack (e.g. Power Platform, Azure AI etc)
  • Act as key subject matter expert for use of the legal technology stack to include:
    • how the platform is set up, use cases and functionality
    • accountability for developing, updating and maintaining guidance documents for users
    • accountability for training users within Legal who need to interact with the platform
    • accountability for creating, collating and maintaining training resources for users
    • act as a key contact with regard to the various platforms
  • Support the business case and onboarding of new technology including:
    • working with the implementation project teams to provide relevant information required for a new technology project
    • input as to requirements from a business as usual perspective
    • work closely to transition new technology into business as usual management
    • accountable to manage rollout to the wider team, upskilling and adoption
  • Support the ambition of the Legal Department to be AI native including:
    • champion greater adoption and usage of legal technology and other enterprise technology
    • understand the use of technology and AI in the legal and financial services sector - stay at the cutting edge of developments
    • accountable for the arrangement of regular knowledge sharing sessions and presentations from different teams about their use of technology / AI and use cases
    • identify opportunities for process improvement, leveraging automation and technology to improve scalability and efficiency
  • Support initiatives between Legal and other functions / front office teams to develop technology solutions for more efficient workflows

Data management and reporting

  • Act as key subject matter expert for key data which is generated by and managed by the Legal Department
  • Responsible to prepare periodic reports, dashboards and presentations on key statistics relating to technology use and key data captured in technology tools
  • Use available tools to build dashboards e.g. PowerBI, Tableau etc
  • Responsible to analyse data captured by the various tools and identify issues and opportunities for consideration

Governance and risk management

  • Understand organisation governance requirements for use of technology by the Legal Department and act as a champion for governance and risk management (including organising regular training sessions to refresh understanding of governance and usage guidance etc)
  • Update and maintain the Legal AI Usage Guidance
  • Attend regular Legal AI Usage Oversight Group sessions and oversee delivery of action points
  • Ensure proper documentation of risks, controls, issues and events relating to use of technology
  • Responsible for control testing and audit responses relating to use of technology by Legal

General MGS team support

  • Other administrative and operational tasks as required from time to time e.g. travel arrangements for visitors to MGS

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Functional / Technical Competencies:

  • 7+ years hands on experience with legal operations and legal technology in an in-house legal department, top law firm, Big 4 consultancy or ALSP (experience of working with international clients) including experience onboarding new technology
  • University degree (or equivalent)

About Lokal:

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
  • Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we ve built, they don t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital

Location: Kochi (Onsite)

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. About the Role

The IT Infrastructure Engineer is a hands-on, execution-focused role responsible for the successful implementation, deployment, and operational handover of core IT infrastructure projects across Cyncly s global environment.

This position focuses on the Infrastructure Project and Operations-taking infrastructure designs and turning them into stable, secure, and scalable production systems. The Engineer will primarily be involved in configuring, deploying, and optimizing solutions encompassing cloud platforms (Azure/AWS), network systems, servers, storage, and virtualization technologies. A strong background in project execution and rigorous adherence to best practices and security standards is essential for success.

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure Delivery & Deployment

  • Execute and deliver complex infrastructure projects, ensuring solutions are deployed successfully, on time, within budget, and adhere to technical specifications.
  • Perform configuration, deployment, and integration of core infrastructure components, including network devices (routing, switching, firewalls), physical and virtual servers, and storage systems (SAN/NAS).
  • Lead the deployment and configuration of enterprise cloud services, specifically focusing on Microsoft Azure and AWS IaaS and PaaS environments.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture and security teams to implement and enforce security measures during all deployment phases, ensuring infrastructure compliance.

Operational Efficiency & Automation

  • Develop and implement automation and orchestration solutions (e.g., PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform) to streamline infrastructure deployments, configurations, and lifecycle management.
  • Participate in capacity planning and scalability assessments, ensuring implemented solutions are future-proof and can accommodate projected growth.
  • Use of AI to improve the outcomes
  • Work with Operations teams to facilitate smooth handovers of new infrastructure components, including developing runbooks and troubleshooting guides.
  • Monitor system performance during and after deployment, performing optimization and fine-tuning to guarantee maximum performance and availability.

Support and Documentation

  • Provide L3-L4 troubleshooting and technical expertise to resolve complex, escalated infrastructure issues and perform root cause analysis (RCA).
  • Maintain comprehensive and accurate documentation of all infrastructure configurations, deployment procedures, and support guides.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in infrastructure and cloud engineering.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 6-8+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure engineering, with a specific focus on projects & Operations.
  • In-depth, hands-on experience with:
  • Cloud Platforms: Configuration and deployment within Azure and/or AWS environments.
  • Server Administration: Expertise in both Windows Server and Linux operating systems.
  • Virtualization: Proven experience with platforms like VMware vSphere or Microsoft Hyper-V.
  • Networking: Strong understanding of network protocols, routing, switching, VPNs, and firewall management.
  • Proficiency in scripting or automation tools (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code).
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a track record of diagnosing and resolving complex infrastructure deployment challenges.

Desired Skills and Certifications

  • Relevant professional certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, VMware VCP).
  • Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) frameworks, such as ITIL.
  • Knowledge of DevOps principles, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, methodologies.
  • Experience in supporting backup and disaster recovery solutions.

Working for us:

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - come join us.

Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Senior AI Forward Deployed Engineer - Cogentiq I2C (Invoice-to-Cash)

Role summary

You own the technical success of Cogentiq I2C at a portfolio of strategic accounts. You take a business problem that arrives stated in finance terms, reduce our days sales outstanding, stop writing off small-balance deductions, and turn it into a production AI system that the customer s finance organisation actually uses.

You lead a small deployment team. You make the architecture calls. You are the person the customer sponsor calls when something is wrong, and the person who tells them what we will not build. This is an engineering role. You will still be in the codebase. The difference from the first band is that you also carry the account, the design and the team.

What you will own Account technical ownership
  • Own the technical outcome for a portfolio of accounts, from discovery through production rollout and scale.
  • Set and defend the deployment KPI contract: accuracy, straight-through processing rate, latency, cost per transaction, adoption and business impact.
  • Hold the technical relationship with customer sponsors and IT leadership.
Solution design and architecture
  • Translate ambiguous goals into a solution design covering agent topology, retrieval strategy, human oversight boundaries, integration approach and data model.
  • Make and document the build versus configure versus extend-the-product calls. Decline bespoke work that cannot be maintained across the customer base.
  • Own the integration design against customer ERP, banking and document infrastructure.
Delivery leadership
  • Lead a deployment team of Forward Deployed Engineers and specialists. Scope the work, sequence it and unblock it.
  • Own proof-of-value and pilot scoping, including effort estimates and success criteria that can be measured rather than asserted.
  • Act as incident commander for production failures. Own the root cause analysis and the remediation plan.
Advisory
  • Explain to finance and IT leadership what the system can and cannot do and what residual risk remains after it is deployed.
  • Guide customers on governance, human oversight design, model risk and responsible AI.
Product and asset leadership
  • Convert deployment learnings into reusable assets: reference architectures, connector templates, evaluation packs and deployment accelerators.
  • Bring evidenced feedback to the product roadmap. Distinguish a single customer s preference from a genuine product gap.
What you bring
  • 6 to 10 years building and operating production systems, including at least two years in customer-facing delivery.
  • A track record of taking at least one non-trivial AI system to production and keeping it running afterwards.
  • Strong Python and system design depth.
  • Depth across LLM and agentic architectures, retrieval, evaluation methodology, guardrails and observability.
  • Cloud deployment experience at scale. Azure is preferred given our stack. Containers and orchestration.
  • Enough finance vocabulary to hold a conversation about DSO, deductions, remittance advice, and cash application without a translator or the evident ability to get there within a quarter.
  • Commercial judgement. You can recognise when a customer request has quietly become unpaid scope, and you raise it early.
  • Willingness to travel and embed with customers.
Nice to have
  • AI deployments in regulated industries.
  • Enterprise ERP integration experience, particularly SAP S/4HANA or Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations.
  • Experience mentoring or leading engineers.
  • Pre-sales or solution architecture exposure.
  • Startup or product-building experience where customer feedback shaped what got built.
What success looks like in your first year
  • Two accounts running in production against agreed KPIs.
  • The Forward Deployed Engineers on your team are measurably more capable than when they joined it.
  • At least two reusable assets you produced are in use by another deployment team.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, youll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit Let us know youre interested in a future opportunity by clicking Introduce Yourself in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

Its fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

About Cogentiq I2C

Cogentiq I2C is Fractals agentic AI platform for invoice-to-cash operations, spanning Collections, Cash Application, Deductions, Credit Risk, and Invoice Management. The platform runs on a four-tier architecture: a Next.js application layer, FastAPI services, the Cogentiq APA agentic orchestration layer, and a data estate built on Azure Databricks and PostgreSQL. Deployments land in client Azure tenancies against live ERP data (Dynamics 365, SAP), which means deployment engineering is a first-class discipline, not an afterthought to development.

Why this role, now

The platform has crossed from being built to being deployed. Collections is entering pilot with enterprise clients, and the deployment machinery is real: Databricks Asset Bundles with one-click, script-based deployment; auto-loader ingestion running historical and incremental loads into a common data model; versioned bundles and wheel-file packages delivered through Git and Azure Artifactory; and a quick-start standard under which a newcomer must be able to stand up the full data platform by running one setup script. This role carries that machinery into client environments and makes it hold under client governance, client data, and client timelines. It owns everything between our release artefacts and a running, observable, correctly governed installation; candidates who want to work on agent behaviour and LLM integration should apply to the AI FDE track instead.

What you will do

  • Own the deployment architecture of client installations from environment readiness through hypercare: bundle strategy, environment topology (Dev, QA, production; per-client catalogs), release sequencing, and sign-off that the installation meets the validation standard.

  • Navigate Unity Catalog and platform governance Client and internal IT control catalog and metastore provisioning, storage decisions, and access models. You will assess what their governance model means for our setup scripts, negotiate provisioning paths, and know when a shared-infrastructure convenience creates an SOW, NDA, or data-isolation problem that must be escalated rather than worked around.

  • Set and enforce the platform engineering standards: idempotent, rerunnable deployments; fail-fast error handling with no silent except-and-continue paths; environment-variable-driven parameterisation with a single point of change per client value; and configuration conventions that hold across Databricks today and Fabric tomorrow.

  • Own the shared utilities architecture: interface-function contracts and factory-pattern abstractions across Databricks, Fabric, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, and storage back ends, packaged as versioned wheel files through Azure Artifactory, so swapping a clients platform is a configuration change, not a rewrite.

  • Make the hard ingestion calls: auto-loader versus custom conflict-driven ingestion when the client will not provision Databricks, checkpoint and reprocessing strategy, retry and alerting design per pipeline, and writeback reliability to the application database.

  • Run incident command during deployment and hypercare. When a deployment breaks in a client environment, you run the incident: triage across the data estate, the application database, and upstream ERP feeds; communicate honestly with the client; and land the fix and the post-incident correction to the playbook.

  • Own the deployment playbook as a product. The quick-start guides, validation suites, and synthetic data configurations you leave behind must make the next deployment cheaper. The bar is that a newcomer deploys the platform from your playbook with one setup script.

  • Coach junior Platform FDEs, reviewing their work against the standards you set and growing them toward deployment ownership.

What You need

  • 6 or more years in data platform or deployment engineering, with at least two years deploying into environments you did not control (client tenancies, regulated environments, or equivalent).

  • Deep Azure Databricks: Asset Bundles, workflows, Unity Catalog and metastore governance, cluster and library management, service-principal automation, and the CLI.

  • Strong Python and SQL, with the judgement to review pipeline code for idempotency, failure behaviour, and configuration hygiene, not just correctness.

  • PostgreSQL in production: schema evolution, write reliability, connection behaviour under load.

  • CI/CD for data platforms: Git-based release flows, semantic versioning, artefact repositories, and backward compatibility across component versions.

  • Domain literacy in order-to-cash and accounts receivable data: invoices, receipts, remittances, customer masters, and ERP AR structures in Dynamics 365 or SAP. You cannot validate a deployment whose data you do not understand.

  • Client-facing composure: you will be the technical face of the deployment to client IT and finance stakeholders.

vConstruct is looking for a Project Manager - Planning to support its Construction Management - India (CMI) business unit, where vConstruct functions as a Technology Enabled Project Management Consultant for AI / hyperscale data center projects in India.

Project Manager - Planning for Data Center projects is responsible for developing, monitoring, and controlling integrated project schedules to ensure timely delivery of construction and commissioning activities. The role involves coordinating with clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to manage project sequencing, procurement tracking, progress monitoring, risk mitigation, and recovery planning while ensuring alignment with project milestones, execution priorities, and overall project objectives. Adequate knowledge on Procurement activities which includes different types of MEP equipment, inputs required for defining sizing / capacity, design requirements, knowledge of major equipment suppliers and delivery timelines is preferred.

  • Prepare and baseline integrated master schedules for Data Center projects using Primavera P6 / Microsoft Project covering Civil, Architectural, MEP, ELV, ICT, and Commissioning activities.

  • Track and monitor testing & commissioning activities including Level 1 to Level 5 commissioning and phased handover requirements.

  • Optimize site logistics, material flow, and construction coordination to minimize execution bottlenecks and last-mile inefficiencies.

  • Masters degree in construction management - preferred

  • 15+ years of relevant industry experience.

  • Strong knowledge and hands on experience of using MS Project / Primavera

  • Strong understanding of overall project and construction management for AI / hyperscale data centers

  • Technology-driven mindset; exposure to BIM/VDC tools is an advantage

  • Strong communication and coordination skills

Customer Success Manager - Enterprise Accounts

Location: Bangalore

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 5-8 Years

Reports To: Senior Customer Success Manager


About Mojro

Mojro is an AI-powered logistics optimization and visibility platform used by leading enterprises across FMCG, Dairy, Paints, Retail, CEP and Manufacturing to plan and run transportation better. Our customers move goods at serious scale, and our platform decides how.

We are building out our Customer Success team, and this is a role with real ownership from day one.



The Role

As a Customer Success Manager, you own a portfolio of enterprise accounts across the full customer lifecycle

- onboarding, adoption, value realization, renewal and growth.

You will be the person your customers call first: close enough to their operations to understand what they are actually trying to fix, and credible enough inside Mojro to get it done. You will have a small portfolio rather than a long list, so the work is depth, not coverage.

What Youll Do Own your accounts
  • Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts end to end, from onboarding through renewal
  • Build relationships across the customer organization - operations, supply chain, IT and leadership - so the account never rests on one champion
  • Keep a live account plan for each customer: objectives, adoption, risks and opportunities
  • Bring structure to accounts that need it - work out why adoption has stalled and put a plan in place to fix it
  • Handle the difficult conversations yourself - escalations, resetting expectations, and getting a relationship back on track
Drive adoption and show the value
  • Track adoption, usage and business KPIs, and act early when something moves the wrong way
  • Run scenarios and what-if analyses in the platform yourself, and use them to show customers what better looks like in their own numbers
  • Demonstrate ROI in the customers operational terms - cost per drop, utilization, service levels
Run the account rhythm
  • Run weekly, monthly and quarterly reviews built on adoption and business metrics, not activity updates
  • Drive agreed actions to closure - on both sides of the table
  • Work closely with our Implementation Engineers through onboarding and go-live - including customer-side readiness like UAT sign-off and training - then own the account once it moves to steady state
  • Bring the business context to issue prioritization so Product and Engineering know what actually hurts
  • Use AI-assisted tooling and automation to take the manual work out of reporting and review prep


Own renewals and growth
  • Own renewal readiness and act on churn risk long before it becomes a conversation
  • Build value cases from real adoption evidence
  • Identify expansion opportunities, and bring in Implementation early to sanity-check feasibility
  • Partner with Sales on commercial discussions, upsell and cross-sell


What Were Looking For Experience
  • 5-8 years in Customer Success, Account Management, SaaS Consulting or enterprise Implementation
  • You have owned enterprise B2B SaaS accounts yourself - including the hard conversations and the renewals
  • You can talk us through a specific account you turned around, and what you personally did
  • Exposure to logistics, supply chain, transportation, FMCG/CPG, dairy or manufacturing operations is a real advantage
  • You have built a business case from platform data yourself rather than briefing someone else to do it
Skills
  • Customer Success: account ownership, adoption and value realization, customer health and churn management, review governance, renewal and expansion planning, stakeholder management
  • Analytical: comfortable with usage data, KPIs and reporting; strong Excel/Google Sheets; able to tell a clear story with numbers
  • Product fluency: willing to get properly hands-on with the platform - enough to run a scenario, read the output, and explain the logic of a plan to a customers operations team without escalating
  • AI & automation: practical fluency with AI tools, and the instinct to automate your own repetitive work
  • Languages: professional fluency in English. Because much of this work happens with plant, depot and transport teams, the ability to engage in Kannada and Hindi is preferred; Tamil or Telugu is a bonus
Nice to have
  • Enough API and integration literacy to work out whether an issue sits with the platform, the integration or the customers process before escalating it
  • Familiarity with Jira, HubSpot and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
  • Experience with international or global enterprise customers



Why This Role
  • Named enterprise accounts, owned properly - you are not one of twenty CSMs holding a slice of a list
  • You are joining a Customer Success function while it is still being built, which means your way of working becomes the way it is done here
  • Direct access to Product, Engineering and leadership - the feedback you bring in gets acted on, not filed
